comments.content: Revision movement only triggers the outer retry if assembleTrade reaches Ready. A write between the overview and card reads that changes a fact revision, frame snapshot, or outstanding debt instead makes assembleTrade return ReviewChanged, which bypasses settlement and immediately ends this assembly. Thus a single transient write can still force Refresh rather than re-reading the overview within the retry budget (the same applies to postSaveReview). For revision-bound reads, detect Workspace revision movement on these failure paths too and return Moved when appropriate; preserve the existing behavior for public getTrade.
comments.existing_code:
if (card.kind === 'Moved') return undefined;
      if (card.kind !== 'Ready') return { kind: 'ChangedDuringAssembly' };

comments.content: This introduces a nested ternary, which the review checklist explicitly prohibits. Use a block-bodied settle callback with separate conditional returns for database mismatch and revision mismatch, followed by the Ready return.
